name: Alila Villas Uluwatu
short_description: A 61-pool-villa cliffside resort on Bali's Bukit Peninsula, with every villa carrying a private pool overlooking the Indian Ocean.
ai_summary: Alila Villas Uluwatu occupies a clifftop position on Bali's Bukit Peninsula, with 61 pool villas -- the 52 one-bedroom villas run a spacious 291 square metres, each with a private pool and relaxation cabana overlooking the Indian Ocean. Guests describe the food quality, service, and ocean views as exceptional, with the resort's modern Balinese architecture and art gallery drawing particular praise. The trade-off for the secluded clifftop setting is genuine remoteness: it's a distance from public beaches and restaurants outside the resort, so it suits travelers prioritizing total relaxation over exploring nearby options, and peak-season point redemption rates run notably higher than off-peak.

faqs.question: Does every villa at Alila Villas Uluwatu have a private pool?
faqs.answer: Yes -- all 61 villas, including the 52 one-bedroom villas at 291 square metres, come with a private pool and relaxation cabana overlooking the Indian Ocean, connected to the main living area by walkways and bridges.

faqs.question: Is Alila Villas Uluwatu close to restaurants and beaches outside the resort?
faqs.answer: No -- its clifftop location on the Bukit Peninsula is genuinely remote, so most guests eat and relax on-property rather than venturing out. It suits travelers prioritizing seclusion and total relaxation over exploring nearby dining and beaches.
